title: Frequenza di un oscillatore a 2 gdl
promptHtml: Con scipy.linalg.eigh(K, M) calcola le frequenze proprie (Hz) del sistema dato e mettile in f in ordine crescente.
starter:
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import eigh
M = np.diag([1.0, 1.0])
K = np.array([[2000.0, -1000.0], [-1000.0, 1000.0]])
w2, modi = ...
f = ...
print(f.round(3))
tests:
import numpy as np
w = np.sqrt(np.linalg.eigvalsh(np.array([[2000.0, -1000.0], [-1000.0, 1000.0]])))
assert np.allclose(f, w / (2 * np.pi)), f"frequenze attese {(w / (2 * np.pi)).round(3)}"
solution:
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import eigh
M = np.diag([1.0, 1.0])
K = np.array([[2000.0, -1000.0], [-1000.0, 1000.0]])
w2, modi = eigh(K, M)
f = np.sqrt(w2) / (2 * np.pi)
print(f.round(3))
